procedure.en: Remove the catch cup. Turn the adjustment nut clockwise until you feel resistance; do not overtighten. Note the number under the triangle marker as your reference. Turn counter-clockwise and count clicks from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Remova o recipiente de pó. Gire a porca de ajuste no sentido horário até sentir resistência; não aperte demais. Anote o número sob a marca do triângulo como referência. Gire no sentido anti-horário e conte os cliques a partir dali.

notes: Internal adjustment, 40 clicks per rotation, 18 µm per click of burr travel (Kingrinder), not particle size. Kingrinder's manual lists Turkish and espresso as 'not recommended' on the K0, so no official band exists for either and the Turkish row is omitted. Burr diameter not published. The manual: 'Do not rotate the handle when the grind setting is at 0 or below 16 clicks.' Zero tolerance of 2 clicks is not stated by Kingrinder; it mirrors the K6.
